prompts.title: Korean Food
prompts.full_prompt_content: A realistic Korean food feast set on a dark textured marble table, top-down angled shot. Includes a steaming bowl of red spicy kimchi stew in a black stone pot, a plate of neatly arranged sliced pork belly, a bowl of white rice, and two small dishes of fresh kimchi. Minimalist black tableware, dramatic overhead studio lighting, rich colors, high contrast, commercial food styling look, ultra-realistic.

prompts.title: Mala Hotpot
prompts.full_prompt_content: Top-down flat lay food photography of a vibrant Chinese Shabu-Shabu or Mala Hot Pot feast spread across a light wooden table. In the center, a large stainless steel split pot filled with two types of simmering broths: a fiery red spicy mala broth with star anise on one side, and a clear, golden herbal broth with shiitake mushrooms on the other. Densely surrounding the central pot are numerous square plastic trays in alternating bright red and black colors. The trays showcase an abundant variety of raw ingredients: thinly sliced marbled beef, rolled pork belly, raw minced meat topped with egg yolks, fresh mussels, crab sticks, fish balls, enoki mushrooms, glass noodles, and green leafy vegetables. Clean, bright, and even studio lighting that accentuates the fresh textures and rich colors of the ingredients. Photorealistic, 8k resolution, commercial food styling look.
